_comment: 4B arm. Identical to corpus-boros-mirror-strategy.json except the model: Qwen3.5-4B instead of Qwen3-8B, same frozen notalk-strategy prompt, same Boros mirror. Decides whether the GRPO loop switches to the 4B for 2.27x fewer FLOPs/token. Qwen3.5 emits XML tool calls, so the server must run --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml or every call is fabricated by the recovery path.
